study_question: Does an XGBoost meta-classifier, trained on session-safe candidate features to predict WIN vs LOSS of F1 triple-barrier outcomes at the declared cell, select a candidate subset whose net economic expectancy beats the unconditional fair-coin baseline under the F2 screen?

explicitly_not.not_an_admission_packet: Survival is not decision-path admission; admission requires operator sign-off and the CR registry.
explicitly_not.not_production_wiring: Report-only; no serving, no provenance migration.
explicitly_not.not_the_greeks_study: Stored greeks are era-floored at 1784502281 (~4 admissible sessions at freeze time); the dealer-gamma conditioning study runs when post-epoch history accrues or the chain-archive recompute lands. v1 features are price/time/CUSUM-state only.

ingest_contract.target: binary WIN=1 vs LOSS=0; TIMEOUT/FORCE_FLAT/withheld excluded and counted
ingest_contract.feature_time: as-of signal bar close (T); entry-bar and later data forbidden
ingest_contract.session_grouping: every windowed feature computed from same-session bars only; incomplete windows -> None
ingest_contract.nan_policy: mask-and-drop before fit; a row with any None feature or label is dropped and counted; no imputation anywhere; assert no NaN reaches fit
ingest_contract.era_floor: greeks-derived features require ts_utc >= 1784502281 or rebuilt_from_chain_archive (f1_input_gates.greeks_era_ok); enforced structurally even while the v1 set is price-only
ingest_contract.cross_session_features: overnight gap enters ONLY as the named feature overnight_gap_atr (prev session close -> entry session first open, in ATR_T-1 units); None on the first session

labeling_cell.note: the declared S5 draft cell; F2 found no surviving cell so the declared draft stands

model.name: xgboost.XGBClassifier
model.no_tuning: params frozen; changing after seeing results voids the run

splits.purge: no candidate whose session touches the embargo may appear in train or test

policy_family.rule: select OOS candidates with P(win) >= tau; evaluate selected candidates' realized net bp

screen: F2 machinery verbatim: mean>0, session-block bootstrap CI>0 (B=1000), Holm across the tau family, DSR (n_trials=4, PSR>=0.95), 2x-cost stress, per-policy sign-shuffle null (K=200); PLUS must beat the unconditional all-candidates baseline mean

controls.label_permutation: per fold, train labels shuffled via placebo_shuffle_train_only (seeded); pooled OOS balanced accuracy must satisfy the TWO-SIDED verdict vs chance=0.5 tol=0.06; leakage_stop or anti_signal_stop halts the study
controls.hard_halt: any control breach or any policy surviving on sign-shuffled returns => HALT

audit.two_way: both agents run the acceptance command before any survivor claim
